mapper.sql: c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.body, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{body}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} AND post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} AND post_id = #{postId})
